description: Analyses a V8 .cpuprofile for garbage collection overhead. Reports total GC time as a percentage of profiling duration, broken down by GC type (Scavenger = short-lived object pressure, Mark-Sweep/Mark-Compact = old-space pressure, Incremental = high allocation rate). Flags when GC exceeds a configurable threshold and provides a targeted recommendation. Use to answer: is GC the bottleneck, and what kind of allocation pattern is causing it?

threshold_percent.description: GC percentage above which exceeds_threshold is set to true and a warning is emitted (default: 10)

name: analyze_gc_pressure
